ai_boundary: No LLM/provider call occurs anywhere in this module.
approval_distinction: TemporalPlacement carries no approval/approved/canonical field; a placement is never approved or promoted to canonical knowledge by existing.
as_is_semantics: The material explicitly describes or belongs to the current/existing-state perspective. Does not mean the statement is true, verified, authoritative, or approved.
batch_policy: Each material is separated independently; one invalid item never removes a valid result.
canonical_knowledge_distinction: This module never creates a KnowledgeStatement or any canonical Knowledge Source content.
classification_independence: TemporalPlacement never reads or mutates an R5 ClassificationRecord. Optional correlation (temporal.service.correlate_with_classification) joins the two by material_id only, in a read-only, non-mutating view.
conflict_distinction: Separating AS_IS from TO_BE material is not conflict detection; no conflict object or status is ever created by this module.

duplicate_policy.same_material_id_same_temporal_state: IDEMPOTENT_NO_OP (only the first placement is kept)

external_io_policy: No file, network, provider, or directory-scan activity occurs anywhere in this module. It operates only on already-ingested in-memory MaterialItem records.
gap_distinction: This module never detects or represents a gap between AS_IS and TO_BE material; that is R7's responsibility.
historical_semantics: The material explicitly belongs to a historical context. Does not automatically mean obsolete, superseded, incorrect, or irrelevant.
identity_policy: placement_id is derived via stable_id from (material_id, bucket) only; equivalent placements always produce the same id, and it never depends on current time, randomness, or object identity.
inference_policy: NONE. Only material.temporal_state (as already explicitly supplied to R4) is read. No keyword matching, regex inference, filename/folder inference, SourceType mapping, KnowledgeNature mapping, provenance-origin mapping, classifier mapping, date inference, or LLM interpretation occurs anywhere in this module.
material_linkage: By material_id only (legacy_documenter.knowledge.domain.models.MaterialItem.material_id); no material payload is duplicated inside a TemporalPlacement.
ordering_policy: separate_batch preserves original input order in both accepted and rejected lists; by_bucket() groups accepted placements preserving each bucket's relative input order.
provenance_independence: This module never creates, reads, or mutates R3 ProvenanceGraph state.
security_policy: R6 does not copy or inspect material content, metadata, references, rationale, or classifier identity; it reads only material_id and temporal_state, so there is nothing untrusted to sanitize in its own output.
serialization_policy: Two TemporalPlacements built from the same (material_id, temporal_state) are structurally identical and serialize byte-identically.
source_type_independence: TemporalPlacement is derived only from MaterialItem.temporal_state; MaterialItem.source_type is never read by this module.
supersession_distinction: HISTORICAL never implies or sets KnowledgeStatus.SUPERSEDED.
to_be_semantics: The material explicitly describes or belongs to an intended/target/future-state perspective. Does not mean the target is approved, will be implemented, or is canonical.
unspecified_semantics: No temporal state has been explicitly established. A valid, permanent-until-revisited state, never an error and never guessed away.
